task.pr_title: feat(agent): add streamMessages API for agent streaming

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
I think simply checking `message != null` is not enough. We need to first find the right StreamingOutput by OutputType and then check the message.

| OutputType | 说明 | 是否保留 |
|------------|------|------|
| `AGENT_MODEL_STREAMING` | 模型推理的流式增量内容 | Y |
| `AGENT_MODEL_FINISHED` | 模型推理完成，可获取全量内容 | N |
| `AGENT_TOOL_STREAMING` | 工具调用的流式增量内容 | N |
| `AGENT_TOOL_FINISHED` | 工具调用完成 | Y |
| `AGENT_HOOK_STREAMING` | Hook 节点的流式增量内容 | N |
| `AGENT_HOOK_FINISHED` | Hook 节点完成 | N |

OutputType sample can be found [here](https://github.com/alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba/blob/main/spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework/src/test/java/com/alibaba/cloud/ai/graph/agent/ReactAgentTest.java#L671) in the unit test.

evidence.attached_diff_hunk:
@@ -327,4 +418,20 @@ protected Map buildMessageInput(Object message) { protected abstract StateGraph initGraph() throws GraphStateException; + /** + * Extracts {@link Message} objects from a stream of {@link NodeOutput}. + *

+ * This helper method filters the incoming {@link NodeOutput} stream to retain + * only {@link StreamingOutput} instances that contain a non-null + * {@link Message}, and then maps those outputs to the embedded + * {@link Message} objects. + * + * @param stream the stream of {@link NodeOutput} produced during graph execution + * @return a {@link Flux} emitting only non-null {@link Message} instances + */ + private Flux extractMessages(Flux stream) { + return stream.filter(o -> o instanceof StreamingOutput so && so.message() != null) + .map(o -> ((StreamingOutput) o).message()); + }
evidence.thread_resolution:
gmjneko: this is my oversight, thanks for pointing it out.

In the new commit, I’ve added filter by`OutputType`, keeping only `AGENT_MODEL_STREAMING` and `AGENT_TOOL_FINISHED`.
Please review it again when you have time. Thanks for your time!
